task: Extend the committed Phase 12 companion_transport core minimally so a secure Tauri authority callback can return bounded typed errors and fresh authenticated responses without exposing key material. Preserve existing Handler/start API and all current tests/callers. Add a public bounded HandlerResponse { kind, payload } and SecureHandler type whose callback receives the authenticated WireFrame and returns Result<Option<HandlerResponse>, String> (error text/code must be bounded/redacted). Add start_secure with the same bind/key/lifecycle/session-registry policy. In the secure serve path, authenticate/update the synchronized persistent Session atomically, invoke the callback without exposing key/session internals, map callback errors to a bounded error response, and have the core Session construct/sign a fresh response frame with protocol/client/session, monotonic counter, fresh nonce, canonical HMAC; response signing must occur under the same per-session synchronization so concurrent requests cannot reuse a counter. Reject oversized response kind/payload and never log/persist keys. Keep existing start/Handler behavior unchanged for old tests. Add focused tests for secure response MAC/counter/nonce, typed error response, cross-connection replay, concurrent single-winner, bounds, and stop. Run cargo fmt/check/clippy/focused/full tests and commit only this core API extension as `feat: add secure phase 12 handler` with clean status. No Tauri/Android/docs/Phase13/remote/native subagents/direct edits.
constraints: Use only configured Biel4 App Server Executor in fast mode; no native subagents or alternate backend.
Do not weaken authentication, replay, bind, lifecycle, or raw-secret boundaries.
Keep API backward compatible for existing Handler/start callers.
